subject: Pilot velocity & capacity checklist — PulseMobile onboarding
messages:
From: Sara Voss <sara.voss@pulsemobile.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: ops@pulsemobile.com, contracts@pulsemobile.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding timeline + traffic profile

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the walk-through today. To confirm, PulseMobile will start a closed beta (pilot) with ~10k MAUs and an expected peak of ~600 concurrent inference sessions during weekday U.S. evening windows. The pilot runs Dec 15–Jan 15. Attached is a simple spreadsheet with session cadence by hour and expected token lengths.

Our priorities are: low tail latency (<200ms for typical chat flows), no cold-start spikes near launch, and the ability to burst for demo days on Dec 20 and Jan 5. We anticipate increasing call volume after Jan. 15 if pilot metrics look good.

Can Redwood provision a temporary uplift to account-level burst capacity and a short-term route-level rate increase for the pilot period? Also looping in our contracts team for any SOW/term addendum.

—Sara
PulseMobile

Attachments: pulse_onboard_traffic_model.xlsx
From: michael_grant@redwood.com <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: sara.voss@pulsemobile.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding timeline + traffic profile

Hi Sara — thanks for the detailed cadence. We'll need to coordinate across Product, SRE, and Capacity to ensure a smooth pilot. Quick notes: 

- We can provision an account-level burst allowance for the pilot window; need a formal request for exact rate ceilings.
- For tail latency, we recommend pinning a quantized model variant for the pilot and enabling prefix KV caching for recurrent demo flows.
- To avoid cold-start spikes, we'll suggest a warm-up run 48 hours before each demo day (Dec 18 and Jan 3) that keeps the KV cache hot.

I'll loop in Lauren and Neha to confirm the quota uplift process and runway. Can you confirm whether PulseMobile needs a hard per-minute RPS limit or a token-based soft target?

Sincerely,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Quoted attachment: pulse_onboard_traffic_model.xlsx
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot velocity & capacity checklist — PulseMobile onboarding

Thanks Michael — adding product and ops asks below. Keeping this short so we can get an approval thread to SRE.

Product asks (for the pilot window Dec15–Jan15):
- Route-level burst_enable: enable temporary burst policy on /v1/chat for PulseMobile with a 2.5x multiplier on rate-limits for 48 hours around demo days.
- Default model pin: recommend using redwood-3b-q4f as the pilot model; Product to confirm model selection and quant profile by Dec 6.
- Canary percent: start with 10% traffic routed to pilot variant; ramp to 50% after 24 hours if errors <1%.

SRE/Capacity asks (for Operations):
- Reserve a 2-GPU pool (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) on dedicated infra for the pilot's peak windows. This will be used for warm-up jobs and canary traffic.
- Configure KV-prefetch for recurring demo prompts; ops to add pre-warm cron at 48/24/6 hours ahead of demo days.
- Temporary quota uplift: specify a token-per-minute ceiling and an RPS soft limit; legal will handle billing terms.

Neha — can you prep a short request object (route_quota_request.json) with the numbers so I can route to SRE? Kar, please advise if Dedicated pool reservation is feasible for those dates.

—Lauren
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot velocity & capacity checklist — PulseMobile onboarding

Lauren — attached is a draft quota request JSON and a short traffic summary (pulselines below). I used conservative multipliers to reduce risk:

Summary assumptions from pulse_onboard_traffic_model.xlsx:
- Baseline concurrent sessions (weekday evenings): 600
- Avg tokens per session: 450 (prompt + response)
- Peak hourly sessions during demos: 2,400 (spikes over 20 minutes)

Requested temporary uplifts:
- Account token ceiling: 120M tokens/day during pilot window (soft limit)
- Route rate limit (/v1/chat): 4,000 RPS sustained 5m-window; 12,000 RPS burst ceiling 1m-window for demo events only
- Canary route: route-id:pulse-onboard-canary; initial traffic 10% -> 50%

Attachments: route_quota_request.json

Notes/asks: 
- Ops: will you confirm whether a 2-GPU reservation is sufficient for a 12,000 RPS 1m burst (estimate uses batching & KV caching)?
- Billing: Marissa, I'll need a line-item estimate for temporary uplift charges to feed to contracts.

Thanks — Neha
Product Reliability
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, michael_grant@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 17:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot velocity & capacity checklist — PulseMobile onboarding

Quick ops assessment — we can support the request but with conditions: 

- Dedicated reservation: 2 H100-equivalent GPUs is tight for a 12k RPS 1m burst depending on model size and batching. If PulseMobile accepts redwood-3b-q4f and strict KV prewarm, it looks feasible with aggressive batching and short seq lengths. Otherwise we should move to 4 GPUs for headroom.
- Warm-up plan: we'll schedule the pre-warm jobs and a rehearsal traffic run on Dec 18 (48 hours ahead) and Dec 2 internal rehearsal already suggested. Please ensure PulseMobile provides a reproducible prompt set for KV priming.
- Quota enforcement: ops will implement the route-level burst window only for the demo events via a temporary rule; after the demo window the route falls back to baseline limits automatically.

Action items:
1) Marissa to produce a conservative billing estimate for the uplift (Marissa: target EOD Dec 9).
2) Michael to get PulseMobile confirmation of model pin + formal approval of token-based ceilings by Dec 6.
3) Ops (Karthik) to provision a 2-GPU reservation now; if PulseMobile requests 4 GPUs we'll discuss cost-sharing for the incremental reservation.

I'll open INF-772 with this proposal and tag for SRE sign-off.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood

Forwarded inline: quota numbers (see route_quota_request.json)
